1 (Currently Amended): A column assembly comprising: a chromatography column comprising a __flexible__ seal defining a fluid passage configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit without the use of a ferrule or a threaded compression screw.

3 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit, wherein the tapered portion is configured to mate with a tapered fluid conduit at a diameter of less than __0.050 inches__.

7 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the fluid passage includes a tapered portion configured to seal against a tapered fluid conduit __and is characterized by a small diameter portion having a diameter of less than 0.050 inches__.

9 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the flexible seal is formed of a polyimide, polyether-ether-ketone, or a deformable metal __and is not limited to a specific hardness or flexibility.__

11 (Currently Amended): The column assembly of claim 1, wherein the flexible seal is configured to maintain a seal against a tapered fluid conduit at pressures up to __30,000 psi__.
